WITH patient_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS avg_hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_wbc,
        avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
        AVG(avg_hgb_hct_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM patient_metrics
)
SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    SEX AS sex,
    avg_wbc,
    avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
    avg_hgb_hct_ratio - overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_overall_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE avg_hgb_hct_ratio > overall_mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_overall_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A missing or zero HCT makes that record's HGB/HCT ratio unavailable; AVG ignores unavailable ratios. The overall mean is across patients with a nonmissing patient-level average ratio.
